title: Database OOM crash, no restart
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the database as the broken part, the memory‑limit/OOM problem, and the API 2.3.2 query as the trigger.
option_titles: Rollback API to 2.3.1 and restart PostgreSQL
Increase PostgreSQL memory limit to 2 GiB and restart
root_cause: The API version 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that exceeded the PostgreSQL container's 1 GiB memory limit, causing the Linux OOM killer to terminate the database process (signal 9).
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
check_first: database container logs and restart configuration
